topics.name: Making contrasts
topics.summary: Bir gapda ham yaxshi, ham yomon tomonni aytish uchun although / even though / however / nevertheless ishlatiladi. Ish tanlash haqida gapirganda juda kerak.

usage.text: even though ... — «garchi ... bo'lsa ham». Kuchliroq «although». Gapning o'rtasida yoki boshida.

example.en: I'm sure I'll enjoy it even though the hours are long.
example.uz: Ish soatlari uzun bo'lsa ham, menga yoqishiga ishonaman.

usage.text: Although ..., ... — «Garchi ... bo'lsa ham, ...». Gap boshida bo'lsa, vergul qo'yiladi.

example.en: Although it's hard work, it will be very interesting.
example.uz: Garchi og'ir ish bo'lsa ham, juda qiziq bo'ladi.

usage.text: ... . However, ... — «Biroq, ...». Yangi gap boshida, keyin vergul.

example.en: The job is quite well paid. However, I really don't want to work in an office.
example.uz: Ish ancha yaxshi to'lanadi. Biroq men ofisda ishlashni umuman xohlamayman.

example.en: The pay isn't very good. Nevertheless, I'm choosing this job because I love animals.
example.uz: Maosh unchalik yaxshi emas. Shunga qaramay, bu ishni tanlayapman, chunki hayvonlarni yaxshi ko'raman.

usage.text: I'm interested in ... — «Men ...ga qiziqaman». Nega bu ishni tanlaganingizni tushuntirish uchun. Keyin ot yoki V-ing.

example.en: I'm interested in working with children.
Although it's cold, I'll go out.
I'll go out even though it's cold.
It's cold. However, I'll go out.

topics.tip: Although / even though bilan «but» birga ishlatilmaydi: «Although it's cold, but ...» — xato. However / Nevertheless esa yangi gapni boshlaydi va keyin vergul qo'yiladi.

topics.name: Related verbs and nouns
topics.summary: Ko'p fe'llardan ot yasaladi (-ion, -ment, -ure), ba'zilarida esa fe'l va ot bir xil yoziladi.

example.en: The completion of the bridge took five years.
example.uz: Ko'prikni qurib tugatish besh yil oldi.

example.en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
The first attempt was a failure.

usage.text: Bir xil shakl: attempt, dream, thunder, fall, experience, need — ham fe'l, ham ot.

example.en: I need help. There is a need for more teachers.
example.uz: Menga yordam kerak. Ko'proq o'qituvchiga ehtiyoj bor.

example.en: She attempted to climb the mountain.

topics.tip: Bo'shliqdan oldin a / the / my kabi so'z bo'lsa — ot kerak; to / can / will bo'lsa — fe'l kerak.

mistakes.wrong: Although it was cold, but we went out.
mistakes.right: Although it was cold, we went out.

mistakes.wrong: It's raining, however I'm going out.
mistakes.right: It's raining. However, I'm going out.
mistakes.why: «However» odatda yangi gapni boshlaydi va undan keyin vergul qo'yiladi.
«a great» dan keyin ot kerak — achievement.
